purpose_scope.question: What is the project trying to do, for whom, and within what scope?

summary.value: Chelsea sought to identify housing-related health hazards earlier than reactive enforcement allowed. The project uses linked property and municipal records to predict three categories of code violations and help city government prioritize inspections, although modelling and evaluation cover only previously inspected properties.

purpose.value: Help Chelsea identify housing-related public-health risks earlier and prioritize limited inspection capacity.

task.value: Classify properties by their likelihood of having specified housing-code violations.

target_outcome.value: Binary predictions for any violation, elevated-risk violations, and violations associated with overcrowding.

population_scope.value: Chelsea’s 5,989 residential properties, with model development restricted to 1,611 inspected properties.

intended_use.value: Support Chelsea city government in prioritizing properties for proactive housing inspections.
